questions.stem: Which statement best describes the structure of an ionic compound?

options.text: Small molecules held together by weak forces
A giant ionic lattice with ions arranged in a regular repeating pattern
Layers of atoms with delocalised electrons between them
Long chains of atoms bonded by shared electron pairs

questions.explanation: Ionic compounds form giant ionic lattices - regular three-dimensional structures containing billions of ions. Each positive ion is surrounded by negative ions and vice versa, with strong electrostatic forces acting in all directions.
